videos.title: Backstage: Dodgers
videos.description: Edwin Diaz and Kyle Tucker join the team at Camelback Ranch as the Dodgers prepare for the 2026 season. Roki Sasaki reflects on the ups and downs of his rookie season including his postseason success as a reliever.

videos.title: Backstage: Dodgers
videos.description: Miguel Rojas and Clayton Kershaw are mic'd up as they receive their 2025 World Series championship rings. The Dodgers head back to Toronto where Rojas and Andy Pages relive their biggest World Series moments.

videos.title: Backstage: Dodgers
videos.description: Relief pitcher Will Klein shows off his love for Magic the Gathering and Mookie Betts gives Backstage an inside look at his latest hobby.

videos.title: Backstage: Dodgers
videos.description: An all-access look at outfielder Teoscar Hernandez as he works to get back on the field following a hamstring injury. Plus, a look into Hernandez's life at home as he recalls his son's diagnosis of Autism.

videos.title: Backstage: Dodgers
videos.description: From his early coaching days in San Diego to three-time World Series champion manager, Backstage takes an in-depth look at Dave Roberts' coaching career as he gets his 1,000th win as a major league manager.

videos.description: Two-time Cy Young Award winner Tarik Skubal is acquired at the trade deadline and makes his Dodger debut. Behind the scenes with Dodgers legend Orel Hershiser as he receives his star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

videos.description: Dodgers prospect Josue De Paula is mic'd up as he joins the team in Cincinnati. The Dodgers clinch their 13th NL West division title in the last 14 seasons.

videos.title: Dodgermentary: 1988 Regular Season
videos.description: The Dodgers' historic 1988 regular season, when Kirk Gibson made an immediate impact in spring training, the contentious games against the New York Mets, and Orel Hershiser broke the MLB record for consecutive scoreless innings pitched.

videos.title: Dodgermentary: 1988 NLCS
videos.description: Considered one of the best postseason series in MLB history, the 1988 NLCS supplied all the Hollywood drama fans could ask for. From Mike Scioscia's dramatic game-tying home run in Game 4 to Orel Hershiser pitching a complete game shutout in the series-deciding Game 7, the Dodgers would heroically clinch a berth in the World Series after defeating the New York Mets.

videos.title: Dodgermentary: 1988 World Series
videos.description: Chronicles the 1988 World Series, where the Dodgers faced the heavily favored Athletics. The Dodgers would upset Oakland and win their sixth world championship in franchise history.
